name: Quickbase
description: Query, add, update and delete records in Quickbase apps and tables.

fields.label: Realm hostname
fields.help: The address you sign in at, without https://.

fields.label: User token
fields.help: In Quickbase click your name → My preferences → Manage user tokens → New user token, and copy it.

actions.name: Query records
actions.description: Get records from a table, optionally filtered.

inputs.label: Table ID
inputs.help: The table's ID is the short code in its address, e.g. bq3x4abc5 in /db/bq3x4abc5.

inputs.label: Filter
inputs.help: Quickbase query, e.g. {6.EX.'Open'} (field ID 6 equals Open). Leave blank for all records.

actions.name: Add or update records
actions.description: Insert records, or update them when a key field matches.

inputs.label: Table ID
inputs.help: The table's ID is the short code in its address, e.g. bq3x4abc5 in /db/bq3x4abc5.

inputs.label: Records (JSON list)
inputs.help: Each record maps field IDs to values, e.g. [{"6": {"value": "Hello"}}]. Include field 3 (Record ID) to update.

actions.name: Delete records
actions.description: Delete all records in a table that match a filter.

inputs.label: Table ID
inputs.help: The table's ID is the short code in its address, e.g. bq3x4abc5 in /db/bq3x4abc5.

actions.name: List fields
actions.description: See the field IDs and names of a table.

inputs.label: Table ID
inputs.help: The table's ID is the short code in its address, e.g. bq3x4abc5 in /db/bq3x4abc5.

actions.name: Get app
actions.description: Read an app's name and details.

inputs.label: App ID
inputs.help: The code in the app's address, e.g. bq3x4abc5.
